where: builder.js wargearOf; build (GW's points: band + wargear + enhancement)
why: Cause reproduced on main 769cc30 with an own harness (lite-knights made Shadowkeepers, Shield-Captain with 'Paragon Blade & Praesidium Shield' 25 + Genalchemic Warding 30): build and phone make give 210 (180 without enhancement), pointsUsed 1620, note {export 235, gw 210}; the old step only matched lc(selection) === lc(row), and GW's only row is 'Praesidium Shield'. On the branch: 235 / 205; Pyrithite Spear & Praesidium shield (lower-case s) 235; an all-lower-case bundle 205; Guardian Spear (free) + enhancement 210; two copies 235+225, 205+255 (enhancement on the second), 205+225, 235+200 (shield + spear), all with no note and pointsUsed = export. GW checked in the cached Wahapedia datasheet: YOUR 1ST UNIT COSTS 1 model 180, YOUR 2ND+ 200, per Praesidium Shield 25; Genalchemic Warding 30 pts. Splitting: across the three catalogued factions (137 priced datasheets) GW's wargear rows are only Shield-Captain 'Praesidium Shield' 25 and Tyrannofex 'Acid spray' 10, 'Rupture cannon' 20. No catalogued bundle names two GW-priced items (Tyrannofex's options are single items), so nothing over-charges; every 'and'/',' weapon name (Scything talons and rending claws, Bone cleaver, lash whip and rending claws, Monstrous bonesword and lash whip, Telemon 'Adrathic Desolator, 1 Fist and 1 Projectors', Daemons' Axe and flail etc.) resolves to [] — unchanged. Matching is case-insensitive; exact match is tried before splitting. A nested same-name child is refused earlier by the option check ('option Praesidium Shield ... not recognized'), and the had-path dedupe would charge it once anyway. Latent, not current: a GW row whose own name contains ','/'and' would not be found inside a larger bundle, a count-prefixed item ('2 Hades lascannons') would not match, and a bundle naming one row twice charges it once; none of the 17 cached factions' GW 'per ...' rows (Storm Shield, Hades lascannon, Killsaw, Twin Killsaws, Cyclone Missile Launcher, ...) contain a separator. build-parity --no-render on the branch: 149 checks, 0 failures; P1 6 built byte for byte, 0 differ. The new N tests on the branch's build-parity.js against main's builder.js: the 4 Shield-Captain cases and the paid-option check fail, i.e. 5 fail. The paid-option check does not hard-crash only because I added a fallback in my scratch copy: run as committed it throws TypeError B.wargearOf is not a function. BSData: that check reads nothing from BSData at runtime (only data.js D.datasheets[].options[].choices[].pts), but those option names and pts are written by verify/bs-catalog.js from BSData, so its expected value is BSData's price. When the catalogue is regenerated without BSData it must be rebased onto GW/Wahapedia points, or it will pass vacuously with no paid options.

builder.js pushes a gwNotes entry only when the GW sum differs from the export's unit points (gw !== u.pts). app.html:2013 shows the note only when a.gwPoints is non-empty. Phone render (index.html served from the branch with Playwright, 390 and 320px, no page errors, no overflow): the correct 235 export gives head 1645 / 2000 pts, the unit at 235, and no note. The export pricing the shield at 20 (230) gives 1645 and 'Shield-Captain 230 pts in the export, 235 pts by GW.'. On main the same two exports show 1620 and notes naming 210, which is the reported bug. Further harness cases on the branch also each give exactly one note: export base 170 (225 vs 235), and the second copy priced at 180 (205 vs 225, the first copy has no note). pointsUsed is then the sum of GW's values (1645, 1840).
